name: Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club
description: For a more intimate vibe, visit the city's oldest live music club for authentic jazz, blues, and weekly jam sessions.
longDescription:
The Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club, located at Largo Actor Dias, 51, hosts a week-long series of performances and events from September 24th to September 30th, 2026. As Porto's longest-running live music establishment, it is dedicated to showcasing authentic jazz and blues music. The club regularly features local and international musicians, alongside its popular weekly jam sessions, providing a platform for both established artists and emerging talent within the genres.

Visitors to the Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club can expect an intimate atmosphere, characteristic of a smaller, dedicated music venue. The club's setting fosters a close connection between performers and the audience, suitable for those seeking a focused listening experience. The programming during this week will cater to enthusiasts of jazz and blues, offering a chance to hear live renditions of classic and contemporary pieces.

Admission prices vary depending on the specific performance or event. The club is located in central Porto, within walking distance of several public transport options. It is approximately a 10-minute walk from São Bento metro and train station, and various bus routes serve the surrounding area.
